sloka: तत् शुर्त्वा राज सिंहस्य वाक्यम् अद्भुत विस्तरम् ।हृष्ट रोमा महातेजा विश्वामित्रोऽभ्यभाषत ॥१-१९-१॥
transliteration: tat śurtvā rāja siṁhasya vākyam adbhuta vistaram ।hṛṣṭa romā mahātejā viśvāmitro'bhyabhāṣata ॥1-19-1॥

translations.english: Having heard these wonderful words of Dasaratha, the lion among kings, the brilliant Viswamitra with hair on end replied:
